description: Delete one of the signed-in user's QR codes. Printed copies stop working for good: scans show "no longer active". This cannot be undone. Always warn the user and get a clear yes first, and suggest pausing it instead (update_qr_code with status "paused") if they may want it again.

id.description: The QR id (10 letters and numbers), from my_qr_codes or create_qr_code.

name: delete_qr_code
title: Delete a QR code for good
